goal: STATIC-PANEL SWEEP (wave 5c). Every listed `targets` entry is a hard-coded <NotSimulated*> box in this service's console with NO capability id — it is invisible to the capability registry and to the coverage numbers, and many are STALE (the feature is real now). For EACH one: (1) if the backend already supports it (check core/*_core.py + core/capabilities), replace the static box with the real, live UI; (2) otherwise BUILD it on a real backend (Nano + offline; follow the Offline + Nano parity checklist in consoles/AGENT-UI.md) and render it live; (3) only if it is genuinely impossible locally (real money/hardware/third-party service) replace it with <CapabilityContainer id="..."> backed by a core/capabilities entry at level not_simulated with the concrete reason. When done, this service's directory must contain ZERO bare <NotSimulatedContainer>/<NotSimulated*> usages — the gate now fails on any. Metrics/monitoring panels show real series derived from actual activity (cloudwatch_core.ingest_internal_metric / the cloud's metrics core), never random data. Nothing leaves the simulator. Update capabilities, tests/conformance, smoke.
